description: Dry Times is a task given by Barkeep Daniels of Lakeshire to resupply the town inn with liquor during an ongoing siege. With the Blackrock orc invasion…
intro: Dry Times is a task given by Barkeep Daniels of Lakeshire to resupply the town inn with liquor during an ongoing siege. With the Blackrock orc invasion severing trade routes, Daniels relies on adventurous couriers to fetch specialty alcohol from across Stormwind's territories.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I find myself in quite a pinch here, friend. The bottles are close to running dry. The latest booze shipment is long overdue. The orc invasion has been hell.
Perhaps you can go to work for me?

I need you to pick up a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the Westfall hills, a cask of Merlot from Stormwind, a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire and a skin of Sweet Rum from Goldshire. Bring those back to me and I will see to it you are rewarded.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I need you to pick up a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the Westfall hills, a cask of Merlot from Stormwind, a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire and a skin of Sweet Rum from Goldshire. Bring those back to me and I will see to it you are rewarded.

clips.title: Completion
paras: A job well done, friend! I know well the roads you had to journey to procure this fine array of liquor. But my patrons will be happy once again!
My wife is quite a seamstress. Please accept this cloak she made in return for your services.
